project: Expedia Group Partner - UC2 Contentful Content Model
basis: Sample of 3 pilot templates - as-is migration - free to consolidate
assumptions: As-is applies to the rendered page, not to the content model: consolidation is free provided every observed instance is reproducible pixel-for-pixel.
Scope is the three pilot pages only. The model is not designed to absorb the remaining 83 components of the historical matrix.
Historical matrix (86 components) is reference only; no ID traceability obligation.
Source inventory is inventario-vivo-de-componentes (35 components, C001-C035, internal approval 35/35, client approval PENDING).
Locales: en-US source, translated to de-DE, fr-FR, ja-JP, sv-SE.
A Next.js and Tailwind front end is built as part of this user story: each content type has a matching React component, blocks resolve through a registry keyed on content type.
container_decision: Theme, background, spacing, width, section heading and anchor all live on the Section container (CT01). This removes 4-6 properties from every content block and absorbs three inventory components (C005 Headline, C019 Background Section, C020 Separator). Cost: one extra nesting level in the entry editor - page > section > blocks.

sources.notes: P01 Campaign landing page - inventory Scenario D, inference from live site

components.name: section
components.purpose: Wrapping container that carries all presentation and the section heading; holds the blocks placed inside it
components.notes: The single highest-leverage decision in the model. C005 Headline appears ~10 times as a standalone block purely to title the block below it; as a container property it stops being an authorable component and the heading can never be orphaned from its content.

consolidation.candidates: C013 Card Carousel, C016 News Card Grid, C031 Testimonials
consolidation.test: Same container model; grid/carousel is presentation, card type is a reference constraint
Content model identical; footnote is a style

consolidation.test: Carry no content of their own; they wrap, title and space the blocks inside them
consolidation.result: CT01 section - removes 4-6 properties from every block

consolidation.candidates: C026 Article Header, C033 Author Block
consolidation.test: Page metadata supplies the values, so the block renders rather than being authored

consolidation.candidates: C003 Cookie Banner, C034 Tags and Share, C035 Page Feedback
consolidation.test: Meta info and taxonomy, not page-authored content
Derived from the URL path; authoring it invites it to disagree with the page location
Never placed independently; always part of a parent block
consolidation.result: cta group on CT07, CT08, CT09, CT11

consolidation.candidates: C029 CTA Card into C010 Info Boxes
consolidation.test: cta is mandatory on one and absent on the other; cardinality differs (single vs grid); different editorial job

consolidation.candidates: C014 Video Card into C017 Editorial Card
consolidation.test: link is mandatory on the editorial card and meaningless on the video card; merging would drop the validation

consolidation.candidates: C007 Anchor Navbar into site Navigation
consolidation.test: Lifecycle differs: in-page anchors change with the page, site IA changes with the site
consolidation.result: CT17 anchorNav kept separate - answers the inventory's open question

consolidation.test: Mental model and SEO: the hero is once per page and owns the h1; the promo band is repeatable and never h1

coverage.notes: 5 split-banner instances (3 left, 2 right) resolve to CT08 with mediaPosition; C011 resolves to CT08 with bodyBlock=CT13; ~10 standalone C005 headlines resolve to CT01.heading
Breadcrumb from CT02.showBreadcrumb; promo band uses background=brand
Article header and author block render from CT03 fields and the CT06 reference; tags from CT03.topics; feedback from CT03.showFeedback + CT04

open_questions.question: Is the 'Recommended for you' grid author-picked or query-driven? If query: sort order, filters, and behaviour when it returns nothing.
Lead capture form - submission endpoint, field definitions, progressive disclosure on industry selection, consent and validation rules.
Comparison table on mobile - horizontal scroll or stacked columns?
Are URL slugs localised per locale, or is one slug used across all five?
open_questions.blocks: CT02.slug, CT03.slug; routing in the head

open_questions.question: Does any locale need different imagery, or are assets shared across all locales?
open_questions.blocks: localizable flag on every mediaImage field - disruptive to change once populated

open_questions.question: Cookie consent - does OneTrust remain an external script?
Header mobile menu third level was never captured. Is depth 3 correct?
open_questions.owner: EG - carried over from the inventory

open_questions.question: Which roles may place which blocks on which template? The section allow-list is the enforcement point and needs a policy behind it.
Analytics - what data layer does each block need to emit?
Which Contentful plan is in scope? Content type count, scheduled publishing quota, workflows and multiple environments are all entitlement-dependent.
open_questions.blocks: CT04 scheduling, review workflow, environment strategy
